note: 下班屁股群的「剧本对话」（《第七轮设计》第二节）。只播一次，存档记 flag。群友只聊自己知道的事：他们知道摆渡众包、淘货、喵鱼，但不知道玩家在练 AI，也不会问。step 类型：group = 群友发言（[谁] 文本，间隔 2–4 秒，先显示「正在输入…」）；self = 主角心里话，用桌面底部的文字冒险对话框，点一下继续；choice = YY 输入框换成选项框，玩家点一个就以玩家身份发出去，然后播这个选项的 replies；link = 群友发下载链接卡片（点了打开浏览器下载页）；todo = 往桌面便签加一条待办；wait = 等某个条件。所有 {name} 换成 Sim.AiDisplayName（剧本里目前没用到）。

steps.text: [阿杰] 我的 1080 到了！！淘货上买的，昨天下单今天到
steps.textEn: [A-Jie] My 1080 arrived!! Bought it on Taohuo, ordered yesterday, here today

steps.text: [莉莉] 淘货我天天逛，衣服比商场便宜一半
steps.textEn: [Lili] I browse Taohuo every day. Clothes are half the mall price

steps.text: 群里在晒显卡……我这张卡也撑不了多久了。
steps.textEn: They're showing off GPUs… mine won't hold out much longer.

replies: [莉莉] 网上商城呀，什么都有
[阿杰] 显卡、内存、硬盘，比电脑城便宜，还不用跟老板磨嘴皮
repliesEn: [Lili] An online shop, it has everything
[A-Jie] GPUs, RAM, drives. Cheaper than the computer mall, and no haggling

replies: [阿杰] 五千多，信仰无价
[大伟] 够我交两个月房租了
repliesEn: [A-Jie] Five grand and change. Faith is priceless
[Da Wei] That's two months of my rent

steps.label: 淘货 · 客户端下载（9.8 MB）
steps.text: [莉莉] 客户端链接在这，先看看价格
steps.textEn: [Lili] Here's the client link. Have a look at the prices first

steps.text: 先装上，看看显卡什么价。
steps.textEn: Install it first. See what cards cost.

steps.text: 下载淘货（群里莉莉发的链接）
steps.textEn: Download Taohuo (Lili's link in the group)

steps.text: [阿杰] 我同事在淘货上买了一包「标好的图片」，一万张才几十块
steps.textEn: [A-Jie] A colleague bought a pack of 'labelled photos' on Taohuo. Ten thousand for a few dozen yuan

steps.text: [小刚] 图片还要买？摆渡一搜一大把
steps.textEn: [Xiao Gang] Who buys photos? Search and you get loads

steps.text: [阿杰] 不一样，每张都写好了是啥，猫就写猫，狗就写狗
steps.textEn: [A-Jie] Not the same. Every one says what it is. Cat says cat, dog says dog

steps.text: 每张都写好了答案……这不就是我天天在「教」里干的事？
steps.textEn: Every one already has its answer… isn't that what I do in Teach all day?

replies: [阿杰] 搞人工智能的公司、做毕设的学生。机器要学认图，得先喂它一大堆有答案的图
[阿杰] 说白了，数据就是饲料
repliesEn: [A-Jie] AI companies, students doing theses. A machine learns to see by eating piles of answered pictures
[A-Jie] Data is feed, basically

options.textEn: How do you use it once you buy it?
replies: [阿杰] 下下来是个压缩包，拖进程序里就行，我同事就这么弄的
[小刚] 听着像给游戏装 MOD
repliesEn: [A-Jie] It downloads as a zip, you drag it into the program. That's what my colleague did
[Xiao Gang] Sounds like installing a game mod

replies: [阿杰] 有，好多是大学公开的，贴吧里有人贴网址，直接下
[阿杰] 就是大，ADSL 得下半天
repliesEn: [A-Jie] Yeah, lots are released by universities. People post the URLs on Tieba
[A-Jie] They're big though. Takes ages on ADSL

steps.text: 数据包……下好放进资料文件夹，再拖进「练」。贴吧里说不定还有免费的网址。
steps.textEn: Data packs… download into the folder, drag into Train. Maybe Tieba has free URLs too.

steps.text: 弄一个数据包，拖进「练 › 数据来源」
steps.textEn: Get a data pack and drag it into Train › Data

steps.text: [小刚] 我发现摆渡众包上有基础委托，接之前得先看验收要求
steps.textEn: [Xiao Gang] I found basic contracts on Bodu Crowd. You have to check the acceptance requirements first

steps.text: [大伟] 别光看报酬，看清楚要交付什么
steps.textEn: [Da Wei] Read what you have to deliver, not just what it pays

steps.text: 群里在聊新的接活平台……先听听他们怎么说。
steps.textEn: A new contracting platform… let me hear what they say.

replies: [阿杰] 我同事接过数字识别的活。每单都有自己的质量要求
[小刚] 先看能不能达到要求，再决定接不接
repliesEn: [A-Jie] A colleague took a digit-recognition job. Each contract has its own quality requirement
[Xiao Gang] See whether you can meet it before signing

replies: [小刚] 通过验收才能签约。有的先给一笔签约费，之后持续交付持续结算
[大伟] 每单的价格和要求都得看清楚
repliesEn: [Xiao Gang] You need to pass acceptance before signing. Some pay a signing bonus, then ongoing pay for ongoing deliveries
[Da Wei] Read each contract’s price and requirements

replies: [小刚] 对，没签约之前先看要求
repliesEn: [Xiao Gang] Right. Read the requirements before signing

replies: [小刚] 我贴下面了
repliesEn: [Xiao Gang] I'll put it below

replies: [阿杰] 先看基础委托，要求达不到的不要硬接
repliesEn: [A-Jie] Start with basic contracts. Don't sign what you can't deliver

steps.label: 摆渡众包 · 客户端下载（12.6 MB）
steps.text: [小刚] 链接，拿去
steps.textEn: [Xiao Gang] Link. Take it

steps.text: 先装好，看看有哪些基础委托。
steps.textEn: Install it and see what basic contracts are available.

steps.text: 下载摆渡众包（群里小刚发的链接）
steps.textEn: Download Bodu Crowd (Xiao Gang's link in the group)

steps.text: [小刚] 我们楼下网吧全换 1060 了，旧的 970 全挂喵鱼上
steps.textEn: [Xiao Gang] The internet café downstairs switched to 1060s. All the old 970s are on Miaoyu

steps.text: [阿杰] 二手 970 一千出头，就是不知道被网吧折腾成啥样
steps.textEn: [A-Jie] Used 970s for just over a grand. Who knows what the café did to them though

replies: [小刚] 二手市场，家里闲着的东西都能挂上去卖
[莉莉] 我把前任送的包挂上去了
repliesEn: [Xiao Gang] Second-hand market. Anything lying around, you list it
[Lili] I listed the bag my ex gave me

replies: [阿杰] 看卖家，问清楚用了多久，有没有保修
[大伟] 便宜是真便宜，坏了也是真坏了
repliesEn: [A-Jie] Depends on the seller. Ask how long it was used, and if there's warranty
[Da Wei] Cheap is really cheap. Broken is really broken

steps.label: 喵鱼 · 客户端下载（8.1 MB）
steps.text: [小刚] 链接在这，我还挂了两个手办
steps.textEn: [Xiao Gang] Link's here. I listed two figurines too

steps.text: 下载喵鱼（二手显卡在这儿）
steps.textEn: Download Miaoyu (used GPUs are here)

steps.text: [大伟] 我同事最近在看更复杂的企业订单，各家的质量要求差挺多
steps.textEn: [Da Wei] A colleague is looking at more complex business contracts. Their quality requirements vary a lot

steps.text: [阿杰] 有的还要求实时处理，光看准确率不够
steps.textEn: [A-Jie] Some need real-time processing too. Accuracy alone is not enough

options.textEn: How do you know you qualify?
replies: [大伟] 看每单的验收条件，先达到要求，再签约
[阿杰] 基础单和高阶单分开看
repliesEn: [Da Wei] Read each contract’s acceptance conditions. Meet them before signing
[A-Jie] Keep basic and advanced contracts separate

replies: [大伟] 持续交付，按约定结算；先看清每单的签约费和收入
[小刚] 别只盯着最大的数字
repliesEn: [Da Wei] Ongoing delivery and payment under the contract. Check its signing bonus and income
[Xiao Gang] Don’t just stare at the biggest number

steps.text: 先挑现在能稳定交付的，再考虑更难的订单。
steps.textEn: Start with what I can reliably deliver, then consider harder contracts.

steps.text: 在摆渡众包查看验收要求，签下一份能完成的订单
steps.textEn: Check acceptance requirements on Bodu Crowd and sign a contract you can fulfil

steps.text: [大伟] 加班加到想下棋，有人陪吗
steps.textEn: [Da Wei] Overtime has me wanting to play chess. Anyone?

steps.text: [阿杰] 游戏中心里有象棋五子棋，我天天被电脑虐
steps.textEn: [A-Jie] The Game Center has chess and gomoku. The computer crushes me daily

replies: [大伟] 等我下班
repliesEn: [Da Wei] After I clock off

replies: [阿杰] 简单难度都打不过，别笑
repliesEn: [A-Jie] Can't even beat easy mode. Don't laugh

steps.label: 游戏中心 · 打开已安装的游戏
steps.text: [阿杰] 就是电脑里那个游戏中心，点这儿打开
steps.textEn: [A-Jie] It’s the Game Hub already on the computer. Open it here

steps.text: 打开游戏中心，看看有哪些游戏
steps.textEn: Open Game Hub and browse the games
